messages:
maris-people-ops: FYI were launching a Parental Leave Top-up Scaling pilot to standardize top-ups (primary/secondary parents) and test a 6-12 week phased return-to-work program. Managers: please review the policy draft and complete the short manager checklist + ack by EOD Fri. Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HR/pages/Parental+Topup+Scaling

diego-benefits: TL;dr: top-up tiers now map to tenure and caregiving intensity. Pilot terms: Primary parent up to 12 weeks @ 80% pay (top-up), secondary parent up to 4 weeks @ 50% pay. We've added a phased return option (4 week gradual RTW at 60% FTE). Payroll mapping request below.

hana-legal: Quick legal flags: EU require consultation docs for phased RTW in DE/FR and we need explicit opt-in language for any phased schedule. Also note tax reporting differences in UK for top-ups. I pushed localized addenda to Confluence.

owen-payroll: For payroll we'll need a new pay_code column (PARENT-TOPUP) and a phased_return_flag. Sample CSV please? Also advise on retro pay if manager approves backdate.

maris-people-ops: Sample CSV for payroll mapping (please accept as-is):
```
employee_id,start_date,leave_type,topup_weeks,topup_pct,pay_code,phased_return_flag,notes
321000,2026-10-01,Primary,12,80,PARENT-TOPUP,Yes,Phased RTW 4w at 60%
321001,2026-11-15,Secondary,4,50,PARENT-TOPUP,No,
```

diego-benefits: Note: top-ups are subject to manager sign-off and a short return-to-work plan. Managers must upload the RTW plan to the tracker before payroll cutoff for the month. Added checklist to the handbook page.

rachel-people-manager: Manager Q: If an IC returns part-time under phased RTW, does headcount or benefits eligibility change (e.g., health premiums)?

maris-people-ops: Short answer: benefits remain active through the phased RTW period. Headcount stays the same; please indicate FTE % in the RTW plan so Comp/Payroll can prorate stipends if applicable.

europe-liaison: EMEA note: Hold sending opt-in nudges in DE/FR until local consultation completes. For UK, we need payroll to confirm tax-withholding handling for top-ups; Hana flagged a UK tax note.

hana-legal: Confirmed. UK top-ups considered earnings; Payroll should withhold PAYE and report accordingly. I'll add language to the Confluence page about required receipts and retention (6 years UK).

owen-payroll: Will add PARENT-TOPUP mapping and phased_return_flag to the payroll schema Monday and validate with the sample CSV. For retro pay: payroll can backdate up to one payroll period if form submitted within payroll cutoff; exceptions via comp review.

training-bot: Assigned microlearning "Parental Leave Top-up Pilot: Manager Actions" to managers in pilot cohorts. Due: 2026-09-20. Link: https://training.redwood.com/assignments/parental-topup-2026

diego-benefits: Action items recap: 1) Managers: review policy + upload RTW plan if applicable, 2) Payroll: accept PARENT-TOPUP CSV and confirm withholding rules, 3) Legal: finalize EMEA addenda and retention notes, 4) People Ops: publish pilot cadence and weekly digest. Owners added to tracker.

rachel-people-manager: I'll run this by my team and fill the manager checklist tonight. Where do we upload RTW plans?

maris-people-ops: Upload link (manager sign-off & RTW plan): https://hr-internal.redwood.com/forms/parental-topup/rtw-upload. I'll DM teams in the pilot and post a quick Q&A drop-in next Tue. :white_check_mark:
